items.title: Academic Profile
items.excerpt: Feier Lyu 的学术档案，涵盖爱丁堡与康奈尔的教育经历、两项 AFP 正式成果、研究合作、技术笔记、专利与行业经历。
items.excerpt_en: Feier Lyu’s academic profile, covering education at Edinburgh and Cornell, two AFP publications, research collaboration, technical notes, patents, and industry experience.
items.content: 研究陈述 最近更新： 2026 年 8 月 教育与兴趣 学术记录 行业经历与联系 学术档案 Feier Lyu （Fay Lyu） 教育背景 爱丁堡大学数学本科（BSc Mathematics） 康奈尔大学交换学生，2025–2026 预计 2027 年毕业 研究兴趣 优化理论与形式化验证；当前项目包括面向子模最大化和投影一阶方法的可复用 Isabelle/HOL 基础设施，以及网络定位中的图结构负曲率证书。 发表成果 Feier Lyu. “First-Order Methods for Smooth Convex Optimization in Isabelle/HOL.” Archive of Formal Proofs · 2026年7月 · 独立作者 构建可复用的光滑凸一阶优化 Isabelle/HOL 基础设施，涵盖投影几何、下降论证、投影梯度映射、残差证书、凸收敛率与强凸线性收敛。 AFP 条目 · 证明文档 · 项目回顾 · GitHub Feier Lyu. “Greedy Algorithms for Cardinality-Constrained Submodular Maximization.” Archive of Formal Proofs · 2026年5月 形式化基数约束单调子模最大化的确定性贪心算法与经验证的有状态惰性贪心实现。本人在 Wenda Li 指导下负责完整的 Isabelle/HOL 形式化开发。 AFP 条目 · 证明文档 · DOI 研究经历 与 Prof. Shoham Sabach 的研究合作 2026–至今 围绕网络定位中的结构化负曲率证书与局部逃逸方向开展持续合作。当前研究图结构、不变性与边层级曲率如何在约化 Hessian 中相互作用。 精选技术笔记 Network Localization: Negative-Curvature Structure 与 Prof. Shoham Sabach 开展中的合作研究；2026 年 7 月研究记录整理投影边预算、应力-刚度分解与多边耦合。 TTGDA and Second-Order Tracking 基于既有值函数视角展开的探索性推导。 专利 Anti-Segregation Spreading Method and Device（说明性英译） 法定角色：共同发明人（Co-inventor）。中国发明专利申请，申请号 202411275605.1，审查中。 相关实用新型：Anti-Segregation Spreading Device（说明性英译）；法定角色：共同发明人（Co-inventor）；专利号 ZL202422234130.3，2025年7月4日授权。 设计用于改善工业铺料过程中物料均匀性的机械系统。 行业经历 数据工程实习生 Liblib AI（Beijing Qidian Xingyu Technology Co., Ltd.） 2025 年 6 月–7 月 在阿里云 DataWorks 中编写 SQL，响应运营团队的数据需求，包括多源连接、筛选、聚合与结果验证。 联系方式 Feier Lyu（Fay Lyu） 邮箱： moc.duolci@035reief 可通过邮件联系 Academic Profile Feier Lyu (Fay Lyu) Education BSc Mathematics, University of Edinburgh Exchange student at Cornell University, 2025–2026 Expected graduation: 2027 Research Interests Optimization theory and formal verification. Current projects develop reusable Isabelle/HOL infrastructure for submodular maximization and projected first-order methods, and graph-structured negative-curvature certificates for network localization. Publications Feier Lyu. “First-Order Methods for Smooth Convex Optimization in Isabelle/HOL.” Archive of Formal Proofs · July 2026 · Sole author Develops reusable Isabelle/HOL infrastructure for smooth convex first-order optimization, including projection geometry, descent arguments, projected-gradient mappings, residual certificates, convex convergence rates, and linear convergence under strong convexity. AFP entry · Proof document · Project note · GitHub Feier Lyu. “Greedy Algorithms for Cardinality-Constrained Submodular Maximization.” Archive of Formal Proofs · May 2026 Formalizes deterministic greedy and a verified stateful lazy-greedy implementation for cardinality-constrained monotone submodular maximization. I was responsible for the full Isabelle/HOL development under the supervision of Wenda Li. AFP entry · Proof document · DOI Research Experience Research Collaboration with Prof. Shoham Sabach 2026–Present Ongoing research collaboration with Prof. Shoham Sabach on structural negative-curvature certificates and local escape directions in network localization. Current work studies how graph structure, invariance, and edge-level curvature interact in the reduced Hessian. Selected Technical Notes Network Localization: Negative-Curvature Structure Ongoing joint research with Prof. Shoham Sabach; the July 2026 research record develops projected edge budgets, stress-rigidity structure, and multi-edge coupling. TTGDA and Second-Order Tracking An exploratory derivation through the established value-function viewpoint. Patents Anti-Segregation Spreading Method and Device (descriptive English translation) Role: Co-inventor. Chinese invention patent application, Application No. 202411275605.1, pending. Related utility model: Anti-Segregation Spreading Device (descriptive English translation) ; role: Co-inventor; Patent No. ZL202422234130.3, granted July 4, 2025. Designed a mechanical system to improve material homogeneity in industrial spreading processes. Industry Experience Data Engineering Intern Liblib AI (Beijing Qidian Xingyu Technology Co., Ltd.) Jun 2025 – Jul 2025 Wrote SQL in Alibaba Cloud DataWorks to answer data requests from the operations team, including multi-source joins, filtering, aggregation, and result validation. Contact Feier Lyu (Fay Lyu) Email: moc.duolci@035reief Available by email
